reading_note: A disciple asks about five outward gestures common in human society — peace, greeting, right hand, kiss/embrace, bow, laying-on-of-hands. The teaching reveals that each small natural courtesy is the ultimate of a great spiritual mystery: the five discrete modes of conjunction between heaven and a regenerating soul. The arc has three movements. (1) Descent: Divine Truth (First Man) is sent from the Aeons of Light into the natural mind to combat falsity from evil; heaven gives him peace, the Mother of Life gives him the right hand, the embrace, he bows in humiliation to the God of Truth, and receives the laying-on-of-hands as armor for the contest. (2) Ascent: when the battle is won, the same five mysteries are given again — the very peace he descended in is the peace he ascends in; the Living Spirit gives the right hand, the Father and Mother give the embrace, he worships, and receives the great chirotonia, being seated at the right hand as leader of his brothers in the new aeon. (3) Iteration in every soul: this same fivefold pattern is repeated whenever the form of light meets a soul leaving the body — kiss, embrace, right hand drawn out of the deep, worship of the redeemer, and finally the crown of glory in eternal life. The single arc: how Divine Good and Truth, by five discrete degrees of conjunction, descend into the natural, conquer evil there, and bring the soul home to celestial glory.
